name: Koshi / Kosi
description: Sapta Koshi leaves Nepal's hills at Chatara, passes the Koshi Barrage on the border and floods the plains of north Bihar.

nodes.name: Chatara
nodes.coord_source: Wikipedia coordinates (place, not gauge) (Baraha Kshetra, next to Chatara)
nodes.gauge_note: Nearby official station Barahkshetra: warning 119.3 m, danger 120.3 m, HFL 132.18 m (WRD Bihar Kosi bulletin). The scenario camera uses its own site-relative staff gauge.
